project.title: Microbial community analysis exposed to periodic disturbances in aerobic granular sludge replicate reactors
project.description: Aiming to unravel the ecological processes driving the community dynamics during periodic applied disturbances, the microbial community in replicate reactors was analysed. Knowledge about the resistance and resilience of the microbial community would aid in wastewater treatment management in the event of disturbances.
